propositions: reconcile_check.py is the last core module comparing local state against the vendor snapshot in vendor shape, lazy-loading Jira adapter siblings by path and calling Jira-specific comparison helpers.

The comparison should be canonicalized by mapping the snapshot into local vocabulary via the configured backend's InboundMapper and comparing in local terms, reusing the canonical-differ machinery with no new port surface.

The neutrality gate must remove the reconcile_check carve-out and enforce that reconcile_check.py has no adapters.jira/acli_subprocess import at any depth and no 'adapters/jira/' path-literal by-path load, via both an AST-import case and a source-text case.

Description comparison must use OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote (ADF-fit, no warning) with rstrip tolerance rather than the send-path sanitize_description which emits a truncation warning inappropriate for a read-only diagnostic.

Discrepancy decisions must stay identical to today's for Jira with the reported jira_value kept as the raw snapshot value, except that annotation-label (rebar-status:blocked/cancelled) tickets now reconcile to the correct local status as an intended correctness improvement.
Without canonicalization, reconcile_check would mis-flag every binding on a non-Jira backend, the runny-lens-strafe failure mode.
